newsitem.title: SPAIN: France's EdF to pay Spain 300 bln ptas for breach.
newsitem.headline: France's EdF to pay Spain 300 bln ptas for breach.

text.p: Spain's publicly controlled electrical group Red Electrica de Espana (REE) said on Tuesday it would receive 300 bln pesetas in compensation from Electricite de France (EdF) for breach of contract.

In a statement, REE, which monitors Spain's high-tension electrical network, said the compensation was being made for the breach of a contract signed in 1990 and the funds would be passed on to customers in the form of lower electrical costs.

In 1990, EdF agreed to connect the French electrical network to the Spanish and provide 1,000 megawatts of electricity a year. But France later disallowed the construction because it would have hurt a sensitive ecological area.
